<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/modules/{moduleId}/repos/{moduleRepoId}/folders"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



This call returns the folders that a module can claim as its `pathPrefixes`. The server reads them from its mirror of the default branch, so it shows only committed folders. The list has each folder at the root, and the folders one level inside a root folder that is not a project. It has no folder for dependencies or build output, and no folder with a name that starts with a period. The list has a maximum of 300 folders. If the repository has no commits, the list is empty.
